column2: BO4's real formula is Momentum = Sales ÷ Working_Days, graded against Prior_Momentum × 1.05. Should wiring it also change which DCs get selected for daily visits, or just compute/surface the score?
column3:
1. Score only, don't change selection [session default] — compute real BO4 grades, respect existing 8.5/8.12 exclusion from the DC Visit candidate pool
2. Also re-include Sales in candidate selection — a real behavior change to task selection
3. Type something
column4: PARTIALLY CONFIRMED — Option 1 (don't touch selection) is correct. But the ×1.05 multiplier cited in that session does NOT match this sheet: 4.4 holds category-specific multipliers (Cattle Feed ×1.2, Crop Nutrition ×1.15, Crop Protection ×1.2, Field Crop = seasonal/undefined), and even the original ★ default before being overridden was ×1.15, not ×1.05.
column5: No Metabase check needed for the selection question — that's a config-consistency check, and Section 8.5 only ever defined qualification lists for Visits, Outstanding, PL, and Long-Term; BO4 was never designed to independently generate DC Visit candidates. The ×1.05 figure itself has no source anywhere in this workbook — likely hardcoded or pulled from outside this config.
column6: Selection logic: no changes needed, BO4 continues to feed Layer 3's priority score (7.2) only. Multiplier: correct the session to use 4.4's real category-specific values before BO4 grading goes live — see Guardrail GR-25 below

column2: task_management_taskdetails (the per-DC-visit check-in table) has ~1 row per task, one timestamp, no per-visit check-out. Visit_Duration_Minutes has no confirmed direct source, so it couldn't be Check_Out - Check_In at the per-visit level. What should it measure instead?
column3:
1. Flag Config_Ambiguous and block BO2 grading until resolved
2. Business sets a flat assumed duration for all visits
3. Wait for a future per-visit check-out field to be added
column4: RESOLVED — Option 2. Business decision: flat 45 minutes for every visit, used for both planning and BO2 grading. No longer Config_Ambiguous.
column5: task_management_taskdetails confirmed to carry a single check-in timestamp only (633,734 distinct tasks across 633,795 rows) — no per-visit check-out exists anywhere in the data model.
column6: Since 45 ≥ 10, BO2's duration condition in Valid_Visit now always passes — grading effectively reduces to Photo_Logged alone. Updated in 2.1 above. This same finding is also the stated rationale the Routing Agent used for treating google_distance as a whole-shift total rather than per-leg (see next row)
